newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Sappi Ltd man in S.African "smear" bid.
newsitem.headline: Sappi Ltd man in S.African "smear" bid.

text.p: Pulp and paper group Sappi Ltd said on Tuesday one of its employees conducted "a smear campaign" to discourage foreign investment in South Africa, but the company had nothing to do with his actions.

It said in a statement that the man was retiring from Sappi at the end of the month and "initiated the campaign in his personal capacity." The campaign consisted of sending negative press cuttings about South Africa to people overseas.
"Sappi is a very committed South African company and totally distances itself from these actions," managing director Ian Forbes said.
"It should be recognised that people's personal political beliefs are just that and do not represent the view of the company."
Business Report newspaper said on Tuesday the campaign had been brought to the attention of Deputy President Thabo Mbeki.

It quoted a spokesman for Mbeki as saying the press clippings sent out by the Sappi employee emphasised South Africa's crime problem and "appeared to be a conspiracy to show the country was becoming ungovernable."
